title.narrative: Activity under preparation Harnessing culture and creativity for sustainable development (Window 4) - AAP2024BA

description.narrative: The overall objective of the proposed Action is to enhance socio-economic impact of the cultural and creative sectors in BiH which is consistent with IPA III objectives to strengthen economic and social development, including through the socio-economic recovery of the region and development of human capital by increasing assistance in culture area. The outcome of the Action is: Enhanced cultural and creative sectors capacities for fostering cultural diversity and intercultural dialogue in BiH.The specific objective of the Action is to enhance cultural and creative sectors capacities for fostering cultural diversity and intercultural dialogue in BiH which will be accomplished through the creation and utilisation of the cultural facilities. These facilities would send a clear message that a positive and progressive project of highest artistic value and with long-term development prospects is possible. These facilities would serve as cultural hubs for young creative people, enabling interaction among young people and in such a way eventually advance reconciliation process. Furthermore, through reconstruction and construction of cultural facilities, the City of Sarajevo, Banja Luka and Mostar will gain greater institutional and professional resources, tools, and capacities for the protection and promotion of contemporary arts and cultural diversity, strengthening its international presence in the artistic and cultural field and contributing to the socio-economic development of the country. This will serve as a positive promotion of the cities, BiH and the Balkan region. In the long run all activities will promote and safeguard cultural diversity of the country, but also greatly contribute to the enhancement of social cohesion in the country, in the form of gathering people of common cultural interest and different cultural backgrounds.
